name: padelbuddy-web
description: A mobile-first, client-only Padel score tracker optimized for courtside use with Bluetooth remote and touch controls.

scripts.mobile:sync: node scripts/sync-android-version.mjs && node scripts/sync-ios-version.mjs && VITE_IS_NATIVE=true pnpm build && pnpm exec cap sync
scripts.mobile:open:android: pnpm mobile:sync && pnpm exec cap open android
scripts.mobile:open:ios: pnpm mobile:sync && pnpm exec cap open ios
scripts.mobile:build:android: . .env && export PATH="$PATH:$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools/36.1.0" && pnpm mobile:sync && if [ "${ANDROID_RELEASE_TYPE}" = "AAB" ]; then SIGNING_TYPE=jarsigner; else SIGNING_TYPE=apksigner; fi && pnpm exec cap build android --keystorepath "${ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PATH}" --keystorepass "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" --keystorealias "${ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS}" --keystorealiaspass "$ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD" --signing-type "$SIGNING_TYPE" --androidreleasetype "${ANDROID_RELEASE_TYPE}"
scripts.mobile:build:ios: . .env && pnpm mobile:sync && pnpm exec cap build ios --scheme App --configuration Release --xcode-export-method app-store-connect
scripts.complete-check: pnpm knip:fix && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint:fix && pnpm format && pnpm test && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm build
